chunks: And it was narrated from her that she said:
"For me to wipe over the back of a donkey in the wilderness is dearer to me than to wipe over my khuff."
ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about wiping over the khuff in wudu (ablution)?
ai.summary: This report conveys disapproval of wiping over the khuff instead of performing the prescribed wiping in wudu (ablution). Its significance is in the jurisprudential discussion of ritual purity and the proper limits of wudu (ablution).

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.97 - It was narrated from Aisha that The Prophet (sw) narrated:
"I would prefer to wipe over the back of a donkey in the wilderness than to wipe over my leather socks (khuffs)."
